project.name: Summer Sound Lemonade Stand
project.goal: Run a profitable, low-friction lemonade stall at Riverside Summer Sounds and serve at least 300 drinks.
project.vision: Use a context-first workflow so planning and execution are grounded in shared documents before task work begins.

planner_outcome.summary: The project has enough context to proceed. Demand should be strongest in the late afternoon, cold storage is critical, a permit/compliance check must be confirmed, and staffing should cover setup, rush-hour service, and closing. A focused, low-complexity menu is recommended for throughput.
identified_risks: ice depletion during the busiest sales window
insufficient cashier coverage during peak queue periods

transcript.text: I want to run a lemonade stall at the Riverside Summer Sounds concert. I have a weather report, an article about the event, supplier contacts, temp worker contacts, and a few recipes.
Great start. Please upload the available documents first so I can ground the plan in shared project context.
Uploaded weather, article, suppliers, temp workers, and recipes.
I see strong demand potential and enough operating context to start planning. I still need permit/compliance confirmation, target sales objective, and whether card payments are required.
Target is 300 drinks sold. Card payments are preferred. I also uploaded the permit checklist.
Thanks. I now have enough context to summarize the situation and recommend unlocking the board.

Summary: The concert should create solid late-afternoon demand for simple cold beverages. The project should prioritize recipe selection, permit confirmation, supply ordering, staffing, payment readiness, signage, and a weather/ice contingency. I recommend unlocking the Kanban board with an initial task set.
